firewall.searchFailed: Could not search records. Check the filters and retry.
firewall.releasePending: Release saved. Waiting for node acknowledgments.
firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.reportHint: Reports remain visible during their detection window and clear when the panel restarts. Ban deadlines are set by the master.
firewall.filterLimit: Use at most 32 conditions, including the IP search.
firewall.deliveryPending: Saved. Delivery to connected nodes is queued; offline nodes reconcile when they reconnect.
firewall.detectionHint: On: report matches and enforce master bans. Off: silently drop rule matches. Geolocation limits remain enforced.
firewall.saveFailed: Could not save the exemption. Retry with the same request.
firewall.invalidIP: Enter an individual public IPv4 or IPv6 address.
firewall.adminHint: Exempt an IP or CIDR from fleet blacklists for the selected hours. Offline nodes apply it when they reconnect.
firewall.adminInvalidPrefix: Enter an IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR.
firewall.adminInvalidHours: Enter a whole number from 1 to 8760 hours.
firewall.globalRulesHint: Thresholds total reports from every node.
firewall.migrationNotice: Different node policies used shared defaults. Review these rules.

automaticLeases.title: Automatic leases
automaticLeases.description: Fresh node activity grants an exact-address firewall exemption across the fleet.
automaticLeases.settingsHint: New leases use the configured duration. Fresh activity after half the current lease renews it for twice that duration. Disabling stops new leases and renewals; existing leases keep their deadlines and synchronize until expiry.
automaticLeases.stale: Showing the last successful snapshot. Delivery and expiry may have changed.
automaticLeases.empty: No matching active leases. Fresh node activity will appear automatically.
automaticLeases.memoryHint: Leases rebuild from fresh reports after a panel restart. Delivered exemptions remain on nodes until their deadlines. Counts cover this panel process.
